profile.supportiveStyleDesc: The coach provides warmth, empathy and motivation. Ideal if you need encouragement and emotional support while working on your goals.
profile.directiveStyleDesc: The coach gives clear steps and challenges you to take action immediately. Ideal if you prefer concrete advice and fast results.
profile.socraticStyleDesc: The coach asks deep questions so you find your own answers. Ideal if you want to develop your critical thinking and self-awareness.
profile.collaborativeStyleDesc: The coach works as a partner, exploring options together with you. Ideal if you like to think out loud and co-create solutions.
profile.twoFactorAuthDesc: Two-Factor Authentication adds an extra layer of security to your account. In addition to your password, you'll need to enter a code from your authenticator app.
